svg.title: Edge Keeps: a map for 4 kings and their peasants
svg.desc: Each king's keep stands on a cliff jutting from the middle of an edge, its ramp facing the loch in the centre. Its peasants live in the corner beside it, clockwise, under the next king's walls: every corner holds one team's peasants and two kings look down on it. A bridge from each keep crosses to the isle.
svg.text: 4 kings, 3 peasants each · 24 × 24 map (12288 game units square) · 4 teams of 4, 16 players
Each king's keep stands on a cliff jutting from the middle of an edge, its ramp facing the loch in the
centre. Its peasants live in the corner beside it, clockwise, under the next king's walls: every corner
holds one team's peasants and two kings look down on it. A bridge from each keep crosses to the isle.
Heights: fields 240 · the basin 220 · keeps 360 · the loch 60 deep · its isle 200
Ground: purple heather and brown peat on the fields, grey granite tors and keep cliffs, black peat
Plants: ad0_fir and treetype pines in shelterbelts round the corners, birchtree by the loch, ferns
Features: rocks30_def granite tors for the corner rocks, legstone cairns on the keeps, rocks30_moss
Sky and weather: grey sky, drifting mist; wind 10 to 25; tidal 12.
Each quarter is the same, turned 90° about the centre. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
